message: Field "Post.createdAt" is optional and its value comes from @default(now()), which Prisma 8 cannot express on an optional field yet. Either fix also changes the Prisma 6 app: a required field makes the Prisma 6 client fail on a stored document that lacks it, and without @default(now()) the Prisma 6 client no longer fills it. Make the field required once every stored document has a value, or set the value in application code and remove @default(now()).

Field "Post.updatedAt" is optional and its value comes from @updatedAt, which Prisma 8 cannot express on an optional field yet. Either fix also changes the Prisma 6 app: a required field makes the Prisma 6 client fail on a stored document that lacks it, and without @updatedAt the Prisma 6 client no longer fills it. Make the field required once every stored document has a value, or set the value in application code and remove @updatedAt.
